issues.informationRequestStatus: No maintainer request for missing reproduction or product information. The owner comment says merged into another requirement but provides no canonical link and is not delivery evidence.
currentFoundation: CharacterCardImportButton already accepts pasted text/files, requires endpoint disclosure and confirmation before model upload, previews candidates, and preserves input on failure.
The planning-material workflow locks the character-roster resource and atomically merges confirmed candidates while preserving author-edited fields.

Character state supports field-level author/derived/legacy provenance, and derived chapter-progress writes are bound to an authoritative finalized source identity and cannot silently overwrite non-derived values.
Long-lived identity still uses normalized character names rather than stable UUIDs, so rename/homonym ambiguity remains an implementation boundary.
issues.acceptanceOwner: character ingestion and character-state evolution owner
issues.requiredOutcome: Ship both halves of the request: (1) import arbitrary supplied prose/outline/worldbuilding into editable character-card candidates, and (2) automatically update the derived character profile after plot progress. Imported candidates require author preview/edit/accept. Plot-progress updates may automatically replace empty or older derived fields only from the current finalized prose and must retain visible source provenance. A value that conflicts with an author/legacy field, or an ambiguous character identity, becomes a proposal requiring resolution; it must never silently replace or reclassify the author fact.
issues.closeGate: UI and persistence prove import accept/edit/reject, automatic non-conflicting derived updates, conflict proposals, stable identity or explicit rename/homonym resolution, idempotence, finalized-source invalidation, project switching/restart, and no write on cancel/failure/stale source. A test must show an unopposed derived change updates automatically, while a conflicting author fact survives and the proposal remains traceable to its finalized chapter. Release the feature before closing completed.

issues.title: [Feature] 云存档功能
issues.body:
### 提交前确认

- [x] 我已搜索现有 Issues，没有找到相同建议。
- [x] 我已移除凭据、完整小说、私人路径和其他敏感信息。

### 要解决的问题

希望作者大大能够增加一个云存档的功能，可以考虑使用gitee仓库进行json格式的存储（这个方案我自己用5.6-sol试过，应该可行，通过一本书绑定一个私人仓库来进行存档，在当前项目里可能还有未知问题和挑战）

### 使用场景

比如一个用户有台式和笔记本两台设备，在外地时只携带了笔记本，笔记本上没有存档和记录，这时候就可以用软件拉取云存档仓库里的内容。

### 期望的变化

用户可以进行云存档。

### 已尝试的方法

将文章导出通过weixin一类的发送然后再导入。这不是很方便。

### 范围与限制

未知。

issues.informationRequestStatus: No unanswered maintainer request for information. The owner explicitly kept the feature open; the WebDAV suggestion is a scope option, not proof of implementation.

reusable: Project manifest/project ID and canonical-root validation
Project session leases and stale-session rejection
Local external-file grants and finalized-manuscript export version guards
Import staging/identity and migration acceptance concepts
SQLite-backed project state and the modernization program's canonical asset inventory
missing: A WebDAV, Gitee, or other remote provider client
WAL-consistent whole-project snapshot and verified restore
Cloud backup/restore UI and product tests
negativeEvidence: The title-bar Backup button is disabled and its localized tooltip says the feature will be implemented later.
Current export supports only merged-md, split-md, and txt finalized-manuscript outputs; it is not a project backup.
No WebDAV/Gitee client or safeStorage/keytar credential layer appears in current source/dependencies.
The existing import-source identity secret is a local HMAC key with mode 0600, not a remote credential vault.

issues.acceptanceOwner: cloud backup/restore owner, with project-storage/migration owner co-signing the snapshot contract
issues.requiredOutcome: Deliver a bounded first provider: manual per-project Back up now and Restore as copy over WebDAV. Use a stable cloudBookId, immutable snapshot generations and a conditional latest pointer. Do not implement real-time collaboration, multi-user merge, arbitrary Git commands, a provider marketplace, or a general cloud platform.
issues.closeGate: A packaged desktop build backs up a representative project from profile/device A and restores it as a new local project ID on profile/device B; data and canonical-asset hashes match; concurrent remote changes produce an explicit conflict; source mutation, wrong credentials, network interruption, corrupt/oversized/unknown-schema archives and malicious paths fail closed; no author content is overwritten and no API/model/cloud secret, global config, absolute path, cache or log enters the archive. The exact limitation and non-E2E-encryption disclosure are visible, and the feature is publicly released.
